<style id='wp-block-template-skip-link-inline-css'>

		.skip-link.screen-reader-text {
			border: 0;
			clip-path: inset(50%);
			height: 1px;
			margin: -1px;
			overflow: hidden;
			padding: 0;
			position: absolute !important;
			width: 1px;
			word-wrap: normal !important;
		}

		.skip-link.screen-reader-text:focus {
			background-color: #eee;
			clip-path: none;
			color: #444;
			display: block;
			font-size: 1em;
			height: auto;
			left: 5px;
			line-height: normal;
			padding: 15px 23px 14px;
			text-decoration: none;
			top: 5px;
			width: auto;
			z-index: 100000;
		}
/*# sourceURL=wp-block-template-skip-link-inline-css */

	var addEvent = function(evt, handler) {
		if (window.addEventListener) {
			document.addEventListener(evt, handler, false);
		} else if (window.attachEvent) {
			document.attachEvent('on' + evt, handler);
		}
	};
	var removeEvent = function(evt, handler) {
		if (window.removeEventListener) {
			document.removeEventListener(evt, handler, false);
		} else if (window.detachEvent) {
			document.detachEvent('on' + evt, handler);

		for (var i = 0; i < evts.length; i++) {
			removeEvent(evts[i], logHuman);

	};

		addEvent(evts[i], logHuman);

<div class="entry-content wp-block-post-content is-layout-constrained wp-block-post-content-is-layout-constrained">
<p>NIRI has two publications that investor relations professionals should not be without.&nbsp;</p>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading" id="h-investor-relations-body-of-knowledge-2-nd-edition">Investor Relations Body of Knowledge, 2<sup>nd</sup> Edition</h3>



<figure class="wp-block-image alignleft size-full is-resized"><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" width="467" height="603" src="https://www.niri.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/BOK-2.png" alt="Body of Knowledge Cover" class="wp-image-6287" style="width:250px" srcset="https://www.niri.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/BOK-2.png 467w, https://www.niri.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/BOK-2-232x300.png 232w" sizes="(max-width: 467px) 100vw, 467px" /></figure>



<p>NIRI&#8217;s <em>Investor Relations Body of Knowledge</em> is the comprehensive resource for investor relations, highlighting the essential practice areas that an IR professional is expected to know in their role. The Body of Knowledge is built around 11 essential practice areas, or &#8220;domains&#8221;, that compose the day-to-day work of IR practitioners, providing information on key IR tasks and the variables that may impact how those tasks are performed.</p>



<p>This 160-page guide is derived from a comprehensive Job Task Analysis of IR practitioners and the contributions of dozens of senior investor relations subject matter experts and other industry leaders. This second edition (2024) bring the contents up to date and reflects new and emerging trends in the practice of IR, including expanded capital markets content and the addition of a new chapter focused on ESG issues.</p>



<p>This publication can be purchased in two formats:</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>Professionally bound hard copy book: $200 NIRI members; $250 nonmembers</li>



<li>Secure, digital-only publication: $100 NIRI members; $150 nonmembers</li>
</ul>

<h4 class="wp-block-heading" id="h-standards-of-practice-for-investor-relations-disclosure-7th-edition">Standards of Practice for Investor Relations: Disclosure, 7th Edition</h4>



<figure class="wp-block-image alignleft size-full is-resized"><a href="https://portal.niri.org/eweb/DynamicPage.aspx?Action=Add&amp;ObjectKeyFrom=1A83491A-9853-4C87-86A4-F7D95601C2E2&amp;WebCode=ProdDetailAdd&amp;DoNotSave=yes&amp;ParentObject=CentralizedOrderEntry&amp;ParentDataObject=Invoice%20Detail&amp;ivd_formkey=69202792-63d7-4ba2-bf4e-a0da41270555&amp;ivd_cst_key=f4e9db5d-62fb-475c-81f3-acde19412a62&amp;ivd_cst_ship_key=f4e9db5d-62fb-475c-81f3-acde19412a62&amp;ivd_prc_prd_key=ad8db4af-c46d-491f-8e02-37d72c96c877"><img decoding="async" width="652" height="843" src="https://niri.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/StandardsOfPractice-cover.png" alt="Standards of Practice Cover" class="wp-image-2292" style="width:250px" srcset="https://www.niri.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/StandardsOfPractice-cover.png 652w, https://www.niri.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/StandardsOfPractice-cover-232x300.png 232w" sizes="(max-width: 652px) 100vw, 652px" /></a></figure>



<p>One of NIRI&#8217;s roles is to set standards of practice for the investor relations profession. Disclosure is a core competency of investor relations. NIRI developed these voluntary guidelines&nbsp;to provide IR professionals with a practical, working document designed to reflect current best practices in all forms of disclosure.&nbsp;NIRI began setting standards for the investor relations profession in 1996, and now thousands of investor relations and other corporate executives use this reference for guidance on disclosure and interaction with analysts and investors.</p>
